import unittest
from gossipmesh.p2p.matrix_clock import MatrixClock


class TestMatrixClock(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_initialization(self):
        mc = MatrixClock(node_id="node-1", max_window=10)
        self.assertEqual(mc.get_clock(), {"node-1": 0})

    def test_increment(self):
        mc = MatrixClock(node_id="node-1")
        clock = mc.increment()
        self.assertEqual(clock["node-1"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(mc.get_clock()["node-1"], 1)

    def test_update_and_causality(self):
        mc = MatrixClock(node_id="node-1")
        # node-2 sends clock {"node-2": 1}
        self.assertTrue(mc.satisfies_causality("node-2", {"node-2": 1}))
        
        # If node-2 sends {"node-2": 2} when local node-2 is 0, it should fail causality
        self.assertFalse(mc.satisfies_causality("node-2", {"node-2": 2}))

    def test_buffering_and_reconstruction(self):
        mc = MatrixClock(node_id="node-1")
        # Buffer an out-of-order message from node-2 expecting node-2 time 1 when local is 0
        mc.buffer_payload("node-2", {"node-2": 1}, "msg1")
        
        # Initially nothing deliverable if condition requires exact sequential order, 
        # wait, satisfies_causality for "node-2" with {"node-2": 1} when local node-2 is 0 gives t(1) == local(0) + 1 -> True!
        deliverable = mc.poll_deliverable()
        self.assertEqual(len(deliverable), 1)
        self.assertEqual(deliverable[0], "msg1")
        self.assertEqual(mc.get_clock()["node-2"], 1)

    def test_max_window_eviction(self):
        mc = MatrixClock(node_id="node-1", max_window=2)
        mc.buffer_payload("node-2", {"node-2": 5}, "stale1")
        mc.buffer_payload("node-2", {"node-2": 6}, "stale2")
        mc.buffer_payload("node-2", {"node-2": 7}, "recent3")
        
        # max_window=2 should have evicted stale1
        self.assertEqual(len(mc._buffer), 2)
        self.assertEqual(mc._buffer[0][2], "stale2")
        self.assertEqual(mc._buffer[1][2], "recent3")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
